sections.text_helper: Section 24.4 "OPAMP functional description" in chapter 24 (Operational amplifier (OPAMP)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 727.
sections.section_content:
Each OPAMP instance can individually be enabled. When disabled, its output is in a
high-impedance state. When enabled, it can operate in functional or in calibration mode.
In functional mode, the inputs and the output of the operational amplifier are connected as
described in Section24.4.8. In calibration mode, they are all disconnected.
Caution: The GPIOs connected to the operational amplifier terminals through the OPAMP
multiplexers must be configured in analog mode (default state), through the corresponding
GPIOx_MODER register.
